admission.justification: Unit tests and synthetic fixtures verify comment/literal skipping, attribute matching, unclosed-comment rejection and challenge-vs-solution routing, preventing missed forbidden tokens or false positives in comments and literals.

applicability: Lexical static scanning of Lean 4 source files for forbidden tokens and external-code attributes in src/rh_pipeline/audit/static_scan.py.
conditions: Line comments, nested block comments, double-quoted strings, raw strings, char literals and Unicode primed identifiers are lexed before matching the nine forbidden tokens or depth-1 extern/implemented_by attributes.

Entry scope scans the seven required entry/comparator files; full scope scans all .lean files under comparator/ and src/ excluding scripts/; only sorry in src/Challenge.lean or comparator/FormalConjecturesChallenge.lean routes to challenge_findings.
exclusions: Interpolated string expressions (s!"...{expr}...") are skipped as opaque string literals, unclosed string literals do not raise AuditScanError, and root-level .lean files outside src/ and comparator/ are outside full scope.
statement: The Lean 4 lexical static scanner skips line comments, nested block comments, strings, raw strings, and char literals without desyncing on identifier primes, detects word-bounded forbidden tokens and extern/implemented_by attribute forms, raises AuditScanError on unclosed block comments, supports entry and full scopes (excluding scripts/), and routes challenge sorrys separately from non-sorry forbidden tokens.
title: Comment- and literal-aware Lean 4 static scan and challenge/solution split
